fields.title: Steam Community Market record
fields.description: The dataset envelope (_input / _source / _scrapedAt / recordType) on top of Steam's own field names, plus decimal prices and flattened helpers. recordType is ITEM (search), ITEM_OVERVIEW, PRICE_HISTORY or PRICE_POINT, ORDER_BOOK, LISTING, SALE, or ERROR. Steam adds fields without notice, so fields not listed here pass through instead of failing the run.

_input.title: Input
_input.description: The item, URL or search this record came from.

_source.title: Source strategy
_source.description: S1-market-rpc for real records, none on error rows.

_scrapedAt.title: Scraped at
_scrapedAt.description: UTC ISO 8601 timestamp when this record was emitted.

recordType.title: Record type
recordType.description: ITEM, ITEM_OVERVIEW, PRICE_HISTORY, PRICE_POINT, ORDER_BOOK, LISTING, SALE or ERROR.

_error.title: Error
_error.description: Error rows only: item_not_found, commodity_no_listings, no_listings, no_matching_listings, invalid_input, expand_failed, api_contract_changed or request_failed.

appid.title: App id
appid.description: Steam app id of the game (730 = CS2).

type.title: Item type
type.description: e.g. Base Grade Container, Classified Rifle, Covert Knife.

currency.title: Currency
currency.description: ISO code of the prices on this row (follows the proxy country, except search which is always USD).

marketUrl.title: Market URL
marketUrl.description: Steam Community Market page of the item.

sellListings.title: Listings for sale
sellListings.description: ITEM rows: number of sell listings (cSellOrders).

minSellPrice.title: Lowest price
minSellPrice.description: ITEM rows: cheapest listing a buyer pays, decimal (USD).

minSellPriceText.title: Lowest price (text)
minSellPriceText.description: ITEM rows: Steam's formatted cheapest price.

minSellFee.title: Fee in lowest price
minSellFee.description: ITEM rows: Steam + game publisher fee contained in the lowest price.

commodity.title: Commodity
commodity.description: True for interchangeable items (cases, keys, stickers) that trade via the order book.

bucketGroupId.title: Group id
bucketGroupId.description: Id grouping all variants of a skin (e.g. G1807209A023004).

bucketGroupName.title: Group name
bucketGroupName.description: Name of the variant group (e.g. AK-47 | Redline).

spreadPct.title: Spread %
spreadPct.description: Spread as a percentage of the lowest sell order.

buyOrderQuantity.title: Items wanted
buyOrderQuantity.description: Total quantity across all buy orders.

sellOrderQuantity.title: Items for sale
sellOrderQuantity.description: Total quantity across all sell orders.

buyPriceLevels.title: Buy price levels
buyPriceLevels.description: Number of distinct buy prices in the full book.

sellPriceLevels.title: Sell price levels
sellPriceLevels.description: Number of distinct sell prices in the full book.

buyOrders.title: Buy orders
buyOrders.description: Price levels, best first: {price, quantity, cumulativeQuantity}.

sellOrders.title: Sell orders
sellOrders.description: Price levels, best first: {price, quantity, cumulativeQuantity}.

historyPoints.title: History points
historyPoints.description: Number of price history data points (daily, hourly for the most recent month).

firstSaleDate.title: First sale
firstSaleDate.description: Date of the first recorded sale.

lastSaleDate.title: Last sale
lastSaleDate.description: Time of the most recent data point.

lastMedianPrice.title: Last median price
lastMedianPrice.description: Median sale price of the most recent data point.

avgPrice24h.title: Avg price 24h
avgPrice24h.description: Volume-weighted median price over the last 24 hours.

volume24h.title: Sold 24h
volume24h.description: Units sold in the last 24 hours.

avgPrice7d.title: Avg price 7d
avgPrice7d.description: Volume-weighted median price over the last 7 days.

volume7d.title: Sold 7d
volume7d.description: Units sold in the last 7 days.

avgPrice30d.title: Avg price 30d
avgPrice30d.description: Volume-weighted median price over the last 30 days.

volume30d.title: Sold 30d
volume30d.description: Units sold in the last 30 days.

avgPrice90d.title: Avg price 90d
avgPrice90d.description: Volume-weighted median price over the last 90 days.

volume90d.title: Sold 90d
volume90d.description: Units sold in the last 90 days.

avgPrice365d.title: Avg price 1y
avgPrice365d.description: Volume-weighted median price over the last 365 days.

volume365d.title: Sold 1y
volume365d.description: Units sold in the last 365 days.

change7dVs30dPct.title: 7d vs 30d %
change7dVs30dPct.description: How the 7-day average compares to the 30-day average, in percent.

allTimeHighDate.title: All-time high date
allTimeHighDate.description: When the all-time high was recorded.

allTimeLowDate.title: All-time low date
allTimeLowDate.description: When the all-time low was recorded.

totalVolume.title: Total sold
totalVolume.description: Units sold across the whole history.

historyCurrency.title: History currency
historyCurrency.description: ITEM_OVERVIEW rows: currency of the price-history statistics.

prices.title: Price history
prices.description: PRICE_HISTORY rows: [{time, unixTime, medianPrice, volume}], oldest first.

time.title: Time
time.description: PRICE_POINT rows: UTC time of the data point.

unixTime.title: Unix time
unixTime.description: PRICE_POINT rows: Unix timestamp of the data point.

medianPrice.title: Median price
medianPrice.description: PRICE_POINT rows: median sale price in that period.

volume.title: Units sold
volume.description: PRICE_POINT rows: units sold in that period.

listingRank.title: Rank
listingRank.description: LISTING rows: position in the chosen sort order.

price.title: Price
price.description: LISTING rows: what a buyer pays (seller amount + fees), decimal.

assetId.title: Asset id
assetId.description: LISTING rows: id of the item in the seller's inventory.

paintSeed.title: Pattern seed
paintSeed.description: LISTING rows: pattern template (0-1000), drives fade %, blue gem etc.

nameTag.title: Name tag
nameTag.description: LISTING rows: custom name, if any.

stickers.title: Stickers
stickers.description: LISTING rows: applied stickers [{name, classid, wear}].

inspectImages.title: Inspect images
inspectImages.description: LISTING rows: rendered screenshots of this exact copy.

soldAt.title: Sold at
soldAt.description: SALE rows: UTC time of the sale.

soldPrice.title: Sold price
soldPrice.description: SALE rows: sale price, decimal, in the proxy country's currency.

soldPriceText.title: Sold price (text)
soldPriceText.description: SALE rows: Steam's formatted sale price.

listingId.title: Listing id
listingId.description: SALE rows: id of the listing that sold.

tagsByCategory.title: Tags
tagsByCategory.description: ITEM_OVERVIEW rows: {category: tag}, e.g. Rarity, Exterior, Collection.

descriptionText.title: Description
descriptionText.description: ITEM_OVERVIEW rows: the item's description text.

overview.title: Overview
overview.description: Key columns across every record type.

itemOverview.title: Item overview
itemOverview.description: ITEM_OVERVIEW rows: spread, averages, volume and extremes per item.

priceHistory.title: Price history
priceHistory.description: PRICE_POINT rows (perPoint output) and PRICE_HISTORY summary rows.

orderBook.title: Order books
orderBook.description: ORDER_BOOK rows: best bid/ask, depth and price levels.

listings.title: Listings
listings.description: LISTING rows: individual items for sale with float, pattern seed and stickers.

recentSales.title: Recent sales
recentSales.description: SALE rows from the live sales feed.

errors.title: Errors
errors.description: ERROR rows: inputs that could not be served, with the reason.
